definitions.explanation: The enlightened one in Buddhism; a Buddhist deity.
A person who has died (respectful term).
Someone who is extremely kind or forgiving.

examples.japanese: {仏|ほとけ}の{顔|かお}も{三度|さんど}まで。
examples.english: Even Buddha's patience has its limits.
examples.notes: Proverb: even a kind person loses patience after repeated offenses

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}にお{花|はな}を{供|そな}える。
examples.english: To offer flowers to the Buddha/deceased.

examples.japanese: お{寺|てら}で{仏様|ほとけさま}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw Buddha statues at the temple.

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}に{手|て}を{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: To put hands together in prayer for the deceased.

examples.japanese: {仏壇|ぶつだん}に{仏様|ほとけさま}を{祀|まつ}る。
examples.english: To enshrine the deceased at the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: {仏様|ほとけさま}のためにお{経|きょう}をあげる。
examples.english: To chant sutras for the deceased.

examples.japanese: ご{先祖|せんぞ}の{仏様|ほとけさま}。
{彼|かれ}は{仏|ほとけ}のような{人|ひと}だ。
{仏|ほとけ}の{心|こころ}で{許|ゆる}した。
examples.english: I forgave with a merciful heart.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}は{仏|ほとけ}みたいだ。
{仏|ほとけ}の{顔|かお}も{三度|さんど}だよ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{本当|ほんとう}に{仏|ほとけ}だ。

notes:
Has religious, respectful, and colloquial uses.

MEANING 1 - BUDDHA:
・{仏像|ぶつぞう} (Buddha statue)
・{仏教|ぶっきょう} (Buddhism)
・{仏様|ほとけさま} (respectful form)

MEANING 2 - DECEASED:
・{仏様|ほとけさま} (the deceased - respectful)
・{仏壇|ぶつだん} (Buddhist altar)
・Often used euphemistically

PROVERBS:
・{仏|ほとけ}の{顔|かお}も{三度|さんど}(まで) (Even Buddha loses patience after three times)
・{仏|ほとけ}{作|つく}って{魂|たましい}{入|い}れず (Making a Buddha without putting in the soul - incomplete work)

NOTE ON READINGS:
・ほとけ - native Japanese reading (kun'yomi)
・ぶつ - Sino-Japanese reading (on'yomi, used in compounds)
